name: Wing Dribbler
description: Actively pursues the ball and consistently pushes it along the upper (+0.75 y) or lower (-0.75 y) edges of the pitch to bypass central defenders, only cutting inward toward the red goal (+1.51 x) when deep in the opponent's half.

name: Cautious Sweeper
description: Prioritizes defending the blue team's goal by strictly maintaining an X-coordinate closer to the blue goal (-1.5 x) than the ball. It avoids offensive pushes, waiting to intercept and clear the ball only when it enters the defensive half.

name: Opportunistic Poacher
description: Leaves deep ball-gathering to the teammate and loiters high up the pitch near the red team's goal (between +1.0 and +1.5 x). It waits for the ball to be pushed into the offensive third before aggressively converging to push it into the net.

name: Support Midfielder
description: Acts as a central pivot by maintaining a mid-pitch Y position (around 0.0) and trailing slightly behind the ball's X-coordinate. It avoids crowding a teammate who has the ball, staying ready to retrieve loose balls or transition to defense if possession is lost.
